wargear.name: Warp-brand
wargear.summary: A sigil burned into the flesh by one of the Powers, a mark that will not heal.
wargear.text: Every Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Warp-brand adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.

wargear.name: Ruin-shard crown
wargear.summary: A fragment of the Ruinstorm worn as a diadem, bleeding unreality into the air.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Ruin-shard crown has the Fear (2) Special Rule in place of the Fear (1) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Bloodied skull-rack
wargear.summary: A frame of skulls taken from champions, still weeping from the ruin they came from.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Bloodied skull-rack has the Skull Tally Special Rule.

wargear.name: Chime of stolen hours
wargear.summary: A bell whose note drags the surroundings a heartbeat out of step.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Chime of stolen hours has the Slipped Moment Special Rule.

wargear.name: Canker-urn
wargear.summary: A bronze urn that vents a slow, sweet-smelling miasma.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Canker-urn has the Festering Cloud Special Rule.

wargear.name: Mirror-glass aegis
wargear.summary: A hall of mirrors ground into a shield, returning every threat as an unwelcome gift.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Mirror-glass aegis has the Hall of Mirrors Special Rule.

wargear.name: Lash-gall harness
wargear.summary: Barbed rigging cutting into the pack's flanks and driving them into a rage.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Lash-gall harness has the Goaded Pack Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hollow idol
wargear.summary: An effigy of stolen faces that anchors lesser daemons to the world.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hollow idol has the Anchoring Idol Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ruin-barbs
wargear.summary: Quills of hardened unreality that jut out from the hide at every angle.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Ruin-barbs has the Barbed Ruin Special Rule.

rules.name: Warp Rift Tide
rules.summary: The Ruinstorm does not march. It rises, and it keeps rising.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule may be placed in Reserves and arrive by Deep Strike. If it is still in Reserves at the start of its Controlling Player's second Battle Turn, it arrives automatically without making a Reserves Roll.

rules.name: Threads of Fate
rules.summary: The future is a river, and a river can be made to run uphill if you ask it in the right voice.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, up to three friendly Units with this Special Rule may each make a Set-up Move of up to 6". A Unit cannot end this move within 12" of any enemy Model.

rules.name: Skulls for the Throne
rules.summary: Skulls for the Throne. All of them. All at once.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Roll. In a Battle Turn in which it declares a Charge, it must declare it against the closest enemy Unit it can reach.

rules.name: Creeping Rot
rules.summary: It does not hurry. It has never needed to.
rules.text: Enemy Models in base contact with a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Irresistible Allure
rules.summary: They do not want to hurt you. They want you to ask them to.
rules.text: An enemy Unit charged by a Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Assault Phase.

rules.name: Skull Tally
rules.summary: Every champion taken is another notch on the rack.
rules.text: Each time a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule removes an enemy Character as a casualty in the Assault Phase, that Model adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of +2.

rules.name: Slipped Moment
rules.summary: A heartbeat out of step, and the Daemon is elsewhere.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Controlling Player's Battle Turn, a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may be removed from the battlefield and placed in Reserves. It arrives by Deep Strike in the following Battle Turn.

rules.name: Festering Cloud
rules.summary: A slow, sweet-smelling miasma that rots from within.
rules.text: Enemy Models within 3" of a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: Hall of Mirrors
rules.summary: Every threat is returned as an unwelcome gift.
rules.text: Psychic Checks made by enemy Models to target a Model with this Special Rule suffer a -1 modifier. The first time in each battle that a Model with this Special Rule suffers an unsaved Wound from a Shooting Attack, the Unit that made that Shooting Attack suffers one automatic Hit with a Strength of 3 and an AP of –.

rules.name: Goaded Pack
rules.summary: The barbs drive the pack into a rage that outruns its own fear.
rules.text: If the result of a Charge Roll made by a Unit with this Special Rule is less than 6, it counts as 6.

rules.name: Anchoring Idol
rules.summary: Stolen faces hold the lesser daemons to the world a little longer.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of its Controlling Player's Movement Phase, a Unit with this Special Rule may remove one Tactical Status it has gained.

rules.name: Barbed Ruin
rules.summary: Quills of unreality jut out at every angle.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that Charges a Unit with this Special Rule suffers one automatic Hit with a Strength of 4 and an AP of – for each of its Models that is in base contact with a Model with this Special Rule.

armyRules.name: Tethered to the Storm
armyRules.flavor: Ruinstorm daemons are held in the material world by the storm's fury, and slip away when it quiets.
benefits: A Malefic Model adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic in a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge.
A Malefic Model ignores Dangerous Terrain Tests.
drawbacks: At the end of its Controlling Player's Battle Turn, a Malefic Unit that neither made nor suffered an attack in that turn must pass a Cool Check or lose one Model.
armyRules.condition: in a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge

armyRules.name: Anchor of the Storm
armyRules.flavor: Greater powers bind the lesser to their will.
benefits: A friendly Malefic Unit within 12" of a Sovereign, Hierarch, Harbinger, Ascendant Lord or Herald adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: When such a commander is removed as a casualty, every Malefic Unit that was within 12" of it must pass a Cool Check or gain the Stunned Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Shifting Fates
armyRules.flavor: The Changer's servants are never quite where the enemy aimed.
benefits: Shooting Attacks made against a Tzeench Unit from more than 24" away subtract 1 from their Hit Tests.
drawbacks: An enemy Unit that makes a Charge against a Tzeench Unit adds 1 to its Charge Roll.

rites.name: The Gnashing Tide
rites.flavor: The Ruinstorm does not march. It rises, and it keeps rising.
benefits: Daemon Harriers and Riders may fill Troops slots; they, Lesser Daemons and Daemon Swarms gain Line (1).
Those units gain Warp Rift Tide: they may arrive by Deep Strike, and any still in Reserves at the start of the second Battle Turn arrive automatically.
limitations: At least one Lesser Daemons unit is required.
No Lord of War and no War Engine units.
At least half of the Lesser Daemons and Daemon Swarms units must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Gnashing Tide: Line (1), Deep Strike, Warp Rift Tide.

require.note: The tide needs its Lesser Daemons.

rites.name: The Pale Banner of Fate
rites.flavor: The future is a river, and a river can be made to run uphill if you ask it in the right voice.
benefits: Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Tzeench units gain Threads of Fate: after deployment and before the first Battle Turn, up to three Tzeench Units may each make a Set-up Move of up to 6".
limitations: A Lord of Change, Ascendant Lord or Herald of Tzeench is required.
Only Tzeench daemons and Heresy-born war machines: no Ruinstorm units and no Ka'bandha, Cor'bax or Samus.

modifiers.text: The Pale Banner of Fate: Line (1).
The Pale Banner of Fate: Threads of Fate.

rites.name: The Red Tide of Ka'bandha
rites.flavor: Skulls for the throne. All of them. All at once.
benefits: Ruinstorm Daemon Brutes and Blood Slaughterers may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Skulls for the Throne: they add 1 to their Charge Rolls.
limitations: Ka'bandha must be in the army.
No Psykers and no Tzeench units.
A Unit with Skulls for the Throne must charge the closest enemy Unit it can reach.

modifiers.text: The Red Tide: Line (1), Skulls for the Throne.

rites.name: Rot Unbidden
rites.flavor: It does not hurry. It has never needed to.
benefits: The Daemon Behemoth and Greater Daemon Beast may fill Elites slots.

Every Malefic Model gains Creeping Rot (enemy Models in base contact with it subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic), and every Malefic Model except Cor'bax Utterblight, who already has Feel No Pain (5+), gains Feel No Pain (6+).
limitations: Cor'bax Utterblight must be in the army.
Every Malefic Model subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

rites.name: Rapture's Invitation
rites.flavor: They do not want to hurt you. They want you to ask them to.
benefits: Daemon Harriers and Riders gain Fast (1), Outflank and Irresistible Allure: an enemy Unit they charge subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Assault Phase.
limitations: Samus must be in the army.
No Heavy Assault or War Engine units, and no Decimators.

modifiers.text: Rapture's Invitation: Fast (1), Outflank, Irresistible Allure.
